title: The One Ring
hint: Sauron's Ruling Ring, forged in Mount Doom about S.A. 1600; unmade there in T.A. 3019
picture_subject: A plain, smooth band of bright gold with no stone and no marks, lying alone on dark rough stone.

title: Narya
hint: the Ring of Fire, red-stoned Elven ring kept by Círdan and given to Gandalf
picture_subject: A gold ring set with a single deep red stone that glows faintly like an ember, resting on grey cloth.

title: Nenya
hint: the Ring of Adamant, white-stoned Elven ring kept by Galadriel in Lórien
picture_subject: A slender ring of white metal set with one clear white stone that glints like a star, lying on green leaves.

title: Vilya
hint: the Ring of Air, mightiest of the Three, kept by Gil-galad and then Elrond
picture_subject: A gold ring set with one large blue stone, lying on a pale stone ledge under a soft evening sky.

title: Seven Rings
hint: the Rings of Power given to the Dwarf-lords; four were consumed by dragons, three taken by Sauron
picture_subject: Seven heavy gold rings, each set with a different coloured gem, laid in a row on a dark iron anvil.

title: Nine Rings
hint: the Rings of Power given to Men, whose bearers became the Nazgûl
picture_subject: Nine plain rings of pale gold scattered on black stone, faintly shadowed as if smoke drifted over them.

title: Ring of Thrór
hint: last of the Seven, held by Durin's heirs; taken from Thráin II in Dol Guldur, T.A. 2845
picture_subject: A thick gold ring with one square green-blue stone, lying on a heap of old coins in a dim cave.

title: Arkenstone
hint: the Heart of the Mountain, great white gem found under Erebor by Thráin I; buried with Thorin
picture_subject: A large round white gem cut with many facets, shining with its own soft light on a bed of gold coins in darkness.

title: Elessar (the Elfstone)
hint: green gem in an eagle-shaped silver brooch, given by Galadriel to Aragorn in T.A. 3019
picture_subject: A clear green gem set in a silver brooch shaped like a bird with outspread wings, lying on a grey cloak.

title: Star of Elendil
hint: the Elendilmir, white gem bound on the brow of the Kings of Arnor
picture_subject: A single white star-like gem fixed to a fine band of silver, lying on dark blue velvet.

title: Necklace of Girion
hint: necklace of five hundred emeralds that Girion of Dale paid to the Dwarves for his son's armour
picture_subject: A long necklace of many green emeralds on a chain of gold, draped over a dark wooden chest.

title: Phial of Galadriel
hint: crystal phial holding the light of Eärendil's star, given to Frodo in Lórien
picture_subject: A small clear crystal flask that glows with a bright white-silver light from within, standing on black rock.

title: Andúril
hint: Flame of the West, the sword Narsil of Elendil reforged for Aragorn in T.A. 3018
picture_subject: A long straight sword with a bright polished blade and a plain hilt, lying on a dark stone table beside a dark scabbard.

title: Sting
hint: Elvish knife found by Bilbo in the trolls' lair; glows blue when Orcs are near
picture_subject: A short Elvish blade, the size of a long knife, whose edges glow pale blue, lying on a mossy forest floor.

title: Glamdring
hint: Foe-hammer, sword of Turgon of Gondolin, found in the trolls' lair and borne by Gandalf
picture_subject: A long Elvish sword with a gleaming blade and a hilt set with small gems, leaning against grey rock.

title: Orcrist
hint: Goblin-cleaver, sword from Gondolin borne by Thorin and laid on his tomb
picture_subject: A long Elvish sword with a bright blade laid on a stone tomb, a faint gleam along its edge.

title: Mithril coat
hint: Bilbo's shirt of mithril rings, gift of Thorin, worn by Frodo in T.A. 3019
picture_subject: A small shirt of fine silver-white rings that shines like moonlight, spread on a wooden table with a belt of pearls and crystals.

title: Black Arrow
hint: the heirloom arrow of Bard's house that slew Smaug in T.A. 2941
picture_subject: A single long black arrow with dark feathers, resting on a weathered wooden longbow by the water's edge.

title: Barrow-blades
hint: daggers of Westernesse from the Barrow-downs; Merry's blade helped to destroy the Witch-king
picture_subject: Four long leaf-shaped daggers with red and gold patterned blades, laid on dark earth beside old gold.

title: Morgul-knife
hint: the Witch-king's knife that wounded Frodo on Weathertop; its blade melted away
picture_subject: A thin cruel knife with a notched, pale blade that seems to fade into smoke, lying on grass at night.

title: Grond
hint: great battering-ram of Mordor that broke the Gate of Minas Tirith in T.A. 3019
picture_subject: An enormous black iron battering-ram with a head like a snarling wolf, resting on a huge wheeled frame.

title: Guthwinë
hint: Éomer's sword, wielded at Helm's Deep in T.A. 3019
picture_subject: A broad straight sword of Rohan with a plain gilded hilt, lying on a green cloak.

title: Palantír of Orthanc
hint: seeing-stone of Isengard used by Saruman; thrown down by Gríma in T.A. 3019
picture_subject: A smooth dark crystal globe the size of a large ball, with a faint glow deep inside it, resting on wet stone.

title: Anor-stone
hint: palantír of Minas Tirith, used by Denethor II
picture_subject: A smooth crystal globe in which faint flames seem to move, set on a stone pedestal in a dim tower room.

title: Ithil-stone
hint: palantír of Minas Ithil, taken by the Nazgûl and held in Barad-dûr
picture_subject: A dark crystal globe glowing with a cold pale light, resting in a black stone niche.

title: Stone of Elostirion
hint: palantír in the tower on Emyn Beraid that looked only west to the Sea
picture_subject: A crystal globe on a stone sill of a white tower window, catching the light of a far western sky.

title: Red Book of Westmarch
hint: Bilbo's and Frodo's book of the Quest, kept by Sam's heirs
picture_subject: A large thick book bound in red leather, its cover plain and worn, lying closed on a wooden desk beside a candle.

title: Thrór's Map
hint: map of the Lonely Mountain with the secret door, given by Gandalf to Thorin
picture_subject: An old rolled-out parchment map showing a lone mountain and a river, its edges curled, beside a small iron key.

title: Book of Mazarbul
hint: record of Balin's colony in Moria, found by the Fellowship in T.A. 3019
picture_subject: A large battered book, slashed and stained, its pages half burned, lying on a stone tomb in a dark hall.

title: Horn of Gondor
hint: Boromir's great horn, bound with silver; cloven in two at his death
picture_subject: A great wild-ox horn bound with silver, cloven in two, its halves lying on a grey river stone.

title: Horn of the Mark
hint: small silver horn given to Merry by Éowyn; he blew it to rouse the Shire in T.A. 3019
picture_subject: A small silver horn on a green baldric, lying on short grass.

title: Crown of Gondor
hint: the winged white crown of the Kings, set on Aragorn's head in T.A. 3019
picture_subject: A tall white helm-shaped crown with wings of pearl and silver at its sides, seven white gems on the circlet and one bright jewel at the top, on a black cushion.

title: Sceptre of Annúminas
hint: silver rod of the Lords of Andúnië and Kings of Arnor, given to Aragorn
picture_subject: A long rod of silver topped with a small white stone, lying on dark velvet.

title: Standard of Elendil
hint: banner made by Arwen, a White Tree with seven stars and a crown, unfurled at Erech and borne to the Harlond
picture_subject: A black silk banner bearing a white tree in flower under seven white stars and a crown, hanging still from a tall staff.

title: White Tree of Gondor
hint: tree of Minas Tirith descended from Nimloth; a new sapling was found on Mindolluin in T.A. 3019
picture_subject: A slender tree with white bark and white blossoms, standing alone in a paved courtyard beside a fountain.

title: Mallorn
hint: the great golden trees of Lórien; Sam planted one in the Party Field
picture_subject: A towering tree with smooth silver-grey bark and golden leaves, standing alone in a green field.

title: Athelas
hint: kingsfoil, herb of healing used by Aragorn for Frodo, Faramir, Éowyn and Merry
picture_subject: A small bunch of long green leaves steeping in a bowl of steaming water on a wooden table.

title: Lembas
hint: Elvish waybread of Lórien that sustained Frodo and Sam in Mordor
picture_subject: Thin pale cakes of bread, brown at the edges, wrapped in green leaves, lying on a grey cloth.

title: Miruvor
hint: cordial of Imladris that restored the Fellowship on Caradhras
picture_subject: A small leather flask beside a silver cup holding a clear golden liquid, on snowy rock.

title: Mithril
hint: true-silver, the precious metal of Moria
picture_subject: A rough vein of bright silver metal shining in dark rock, with a few small polished ingots beside it.

title: Pipe-weed
hint: leaf grown in the Southfarthing; first planted at Longbottom
picture_subject: Dried brown leaves in a small barrel beside a long wooden pipe, on a wooden bench.

title: Simbelmynë
hint: Evermind, small white flowers that grow on the barrows of the Kings of Rohan
picture_subject: Small white star-shaped flowers covering a green burial mound under a pale sky.

title: Elanor
hint: small golden star-flower of Cerin Amroth in Lórien
picture_subject: Tiny golden star-shaped flowers growing among the grass on a green hill.

title: Galadriel's box
hint: small grey box of Lórien earth and a mallorn nut given to Sam
picture_subject: A small plain box of grey wood, its lid open to show soft earth and a single silver nut.

title: Mirror of Galadriel
hint: silver basin of water in Lórien in which Frodo and Sam saw visions
picture_subject: A wide shallow silver basin on a low stone pedestal, filled with still dark water reflecting stars.

title: Elven-cloaks of Lórien
hint: grey hooded cloaks given to the Fellowship, each fastened with a leaf-shaped brooch
picture_subject: A light grey hooded cloak folded on a branch, with a green and silver brooch shaped like a leaf.

title: Silmarils
hint: the three jewels of Fëanor that held the light of the Two Trees
picture_subject: Three jewels like round crystals, each blazing with white and gold light, set in a dark iron crown.

title: Nauglamír
hint: the Necklace of the Dwarves made for Finrod; remade to hold the Silmaril of Beren and Lúthien
picture_subject: A necklace of gold set with many clear gems, with one bright jewel at its centre, lying on dark stone.

title: Ring of Barahir
hint: ring of twin serpents with green gems given by Finrod to Barahir; heirloom of Aragorn
picture_subject: A gold ring shaped as two twined serpents with emerald eyes, their heads meeting under a crown of golden flowers.

title: Gurthang
hint: the black sword Anglachel, made by Eöl from a fallen star; reforged for Túrin
picture_subject: A long black sword whose dark blade has a pale shining edge, lying on rocks above a gorge.

title: Anguirel
hint: black sword of Eöl, twin of Anglachel, stolen by Maeglin
picture_subject: A long dark sword of black iron with a plain hilt, lying on a smith's bench.

title: Ringil
hint: Fingolfin's sword that glittered like ice; it wounded Morgoth seven times
picture_subject: A long sword with a pale blade that glitters like ice, lying on snow beside a blue shield.

title: Aeglos
hint: the spear of Gil-galad, borne in the Last Alliance
picture_subject: A tall spear with a long, sharp, pale blade like an icicle, leaning against a white stone.

title: Angrist
hint: Curufin's knife made by Telchar, used by Beren to cut a Silmaril from Morgoth's crown
picture_subject: A long knife of grey steel with a plain hilt, lying on black iron.

title: Dragon-helm of Dor-lómin
hint: heirloom helm of the House of Hador with a dragon crest, worn by Túrin
picture_subject: A grey steel helm with a golden dragon crest along its top, standing on a stone table.

title: Belthronding
hint: the great bow of Beleg, buried with him
picture_subject: A tall bow of black yew wood, unstrung, lying on pine needles.

title: Iron Crown
hint: Morgoth's crown of iron that held the Silmarils
picture_subject: A massive crown of black iron with three empty settings for jewels, resting on dark stone.

title: Vingilot
hint: Eärendil's ship, built of Nimbrethil birch; sails the sky bearing a Silmaril
picture_subject: A slender white ship with silver sails and a swan-like prow, sailing above clouds at dusk with a bright light at its bow.

title: Swan-ships of Alqualondë
hint: the white ships of the Teleri, seized by the Noldor in the Kinslaying
picture_subject: White ships with prows shaped like swans' heads and golden eyes, moored in a quiet harbour under a stone arch.

title: Two Trees of Valinor
hint: Telperion the silver and Laurelin the golden, which lit Valinor until Ungoliant killed them
picture_subject: Two great trees on a green mound, one with dark leaves and silver light, the other with pale green leaves and golden flowers.

title: Nimloth
hint: the White Tree of Númenor; Isildur saved its fruit before it was burned
picture_subject: A white tree in flower in a royal courtyard, with one small fruit hanging low.

title: Lamps of the Valar
hint: Illuin and Ormal, the first great lights of Arda, thrown down by Melkor
picture_subject: Two immense lamps on tall stone pillars rising from a dark land, one shining blue-silver, the other gold.
